entities.name: app_settings
entities.sql: CREATE TABLE app_settings (id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT 1 CHECK (id = 1), theme_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system' CHECK (theme_mode IN ('system', 'light', 'dark')), locale_tag TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ar' CHECK (locale_tag = 'ar'), created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0));
